B06.observation: The drawing contains an outer six-sided contour, three crossing main-axis trajectories, two interlaced three-sided figures with six circled filled points, and pale extensions above and to the right. Labels read zeta, -bar-zeta, 1, -zeta, bar-zeta, and 0. Six uncircled off-centre marks and one central mark supplement the six circled marks. Dotted strokes toward the upper-right outer vertex and the remote right endpoint are retained.

drawing_counts.object_definition: math label nodes, separately from point marks

shaft_inventory: Six outer boundary sides, with visible gaps at several vertices.
Three main axes through the central area, each counted as one trajectory despite pen lifts or gaps.
Six sides of the two inner three-sided figures.
Pale upper-left ray beyond the upper-left labeled vertex.
Pale high-apex-to-upper-right segment ending before the label.
Pale high-apex vertical trajectory through the upper circled point.
Broken horizontal extension from the upper-right region toward the remote right endpoint.
Oblique headed shaft from the right-hand region toward that remote endpoint.
Dotted/pale extension from the upper-right circled point toward the remote right endpoint.
Pale diagonal from the right outer region toward the lower-right remote endpoint.
Pale nearly horizontal extension from the lower-right outer region, stopping short of the remote endpoint.
Pale slant from the lower-right circled-point region toward the lower-right remote endpoint.
uncertain_endpoints: Several outer sides stop short of adjoining vertices; the TikZ preserves those gaps.
The dotted arrow toward the upper-right outer vertex stops a little below and left of its main contour corner.
The upper pale apex is a layered loop/blot; whether it is a point, arrowhead, or retraced terminal is unresolved.
The lower-right remote endpoint is a short heavy dash; point versus terminal stroke is unresolved.
The lower nearly horizontal pale extension stops short of that remote dash.
The detached horizontal/right-oblique fragments near the remote upper-right endpoint are kept separate.
doubts: The shaft count refers to visible trajectories; it does not assert a mathematical incidence wherever the ink has a gap.
Dots along the dotted trajectories are stroke units and are excluded from the thirteen point marks.
Five partial retraces are preserved separately: top outer side, high vertical loop, right oblique shaft, inner upper horizontal, and central right horizontal.
